notes.title: Halloween Update | Patch 0.1.2B
notes.content:
[h2]In the spirit of Halloween we present you the new update of The Meaning, we hope you enjoy it and we wish you a spooky holiday!
[/h2]

[h3][b]#Features[/b][/h3]
- Added more sound effects and made the quality of the old ones better
- Reworked the storyline and added more content

[h3][b]#Work in progress[/b][/h3]
- More content is needed to finish the game and the already present content should be made better
- More and better visual and auditory jumpscares
- Better atmosphere
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42417048/64960dccb388b9986ef8f47950c96329cc494d27.png[/img]

- Better inspection of items
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42417048/a741e0981e4a5b4f0d73ae46e458619dcfdcb68a.png[/img]

[h3][b]#Known bugs[/b][/h3]
- We are still working on fixing the achievements  as soon as possible
- Serialization of the map 

[h2][b]We appreciate all the feedback and are really thankful for all the support![/b][/h2]
